claim.precondition: 0 <= left < q and 0 <= right < q, where q is the BN254 scalar order
claim.outsidePrecondition: The harness returns; this is not a proof that inputs outside the precondition are rejected

success_criterion: Kontrol APRProof PASSED, admitted=false, pending=failing=vacuous=stuck=0; retain proof graph and exact input hashes.
scope: Revised alt_bn128.sol byte-identical to EXP-03 source, compiled inside this harness using solc 0.4.19, optimizer=false. The target is this harness bytecode, not the deployed full RangeProofVerifier bytecode.
limits: This proves only the range of sub for canonical uint256 operands. The harness returns outside the precondition; noncanonical-input rejection, modular correctness, precompile behavior, transcript, full range verification and cryptographic security remain outside scope.
No gas-cost claim; gas computations explicitly omitted.
Generic KEVM/Kontrol semantics and SMT solver are trusted; no custom assumptions or admitted proof nodes added.
generic_definition_reuse: Old foundry.k imports KONTROL-FULL and has no target-specific sentences; fixed Kontrol loads deployed bytecode from the new Foundry artifact when constructing the proof. Original compiled definition is copied unchanged then normally serialized. No K build rerun.
